idea-plugin.name: Glass Islands
idea-plugin.description:
Gives Rider on macOS a translucent, Apple-like look built from real AppKit materials, rendered by the macOS compositor: no screenshots, no painted blur, no theme swap.
  • The window and the Islands panes are frosted NSVisualEffectView material, with soft shadows and a specular rim; the editor stays the most opaque layer for readability.
  • Selected and hovered toolbar buttons, tool window buttons and editor tabs become Liquid Glass pills (NSGlassEffectView, macOS 26 and later; frosted pills on earlier versions).
  • Popups and menus use the macOS menu material, floating tool windows the popover material, and detached editor windows get the same islands as the main window. Dialogs stay opaque, as on macOS.
  • Follows the Rider theme (dark or light) and the macOS accessibility settings: Reduce Transparency turns it off, Increase Contrast makes every layer more opaque and outlined. Presentation Mode stays opaque.
  • Every setting applies live: Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Glass Islands, or View | Appearance | Glass Islands to toggle it.
Requires an Islands theme. macOS only (Apple Silicon and Intel); on other systems the plugin stays inactive.
